Need to Know:

So the stalker buddies have been hunted down a fair amount and the event is going well, but the low drop rates of some of the mods combined with the temporary nature of the opportunities left DE with a conundrum, how to stop people jumping into a match then killing the stalker buddy and quiting on a bad drop? Well the solution they went with is to hide the mod in question until the end of the match.

This change has been met with mixed responses, reigniting some of the old anger relating to Draco and other farming strategies. Some people prefer less host migrations as people leave on a common or uncommon mod drop and leave them alone to face the level to get a mod they don't have. But other people see it as a time wasting measure designed to bottleneck the already RNG/Time based nature of the event. To counter the latter drops rates of the uncommon and rare mods the stalker buddies drop has been doubled and the common ones lowered a little to accommodate. Also you can no longer join a game if the session has had a stalker buddy already die in it if you are on it's node, to stop players turning up late and getting nothing.

In addition these changes fixes and rebalances have been included, such as alloy plates being swapped out for ferrite in the void as the resource drop. Radial blind now doesn't break your reloads as well, which does have a small minority of people who used it to animation cancel grumbling, it should be preferable in the long run in any case.

The only other knowlage fragment from this patch is that the stalker buddies will return after this event although the mechanics of these returns in unknown, so if you missed out on a particular buddies drop they will be around in the future eventually so you'll still have a chance to get it without buying it from other players.

Conclave Changes and Fixes:

  • Fixed an issue with public matches becoming private after a Host Migration.
  • Head hits that have no damage multiplier will no longer show yellow/large font numbers in Conclave.

Changes:

  • Ferrite has replaced Alloy Plate as a Resource Drop in Void missions.
  • Increased the mass of Excavator Power Cells so that they don't roll around the map (and out of reach) as easily.
  • Enemies introduced on Operation Shadow Debt can now be scanned to reveal their Codex Entry. If you missed scanning any due to their swift death or otherwise, Acolytes will be introduced to the game outside of the event at a later date.
  • Game sessions can no longer be joined in-progress once an Acolyte Spawns. This prevents players from showing up late and missing out on the encounter entirely.
  • Added changes to reveal method of Acolyte Mod Drops to prevent stress on host-migration and matchmaking in the event of repeated mission aborts. Please note that now any Event Mod dropped by Acolytes will appear with the 'Rare' beacon and only be revealed at mission complete.
  • Changed the default Common/Uncommon/Rare drop rate system for Acolyte enemies to have a more equalized distribution of drops across the rarities. In doing so, the rate that Uncommon and Rare mods drop has been increased by double, and the rate at which Common mods drop has been reduced.

Fixes:

  • Fixed an issue with Mesa's Peacemaker target range ring was barely visible.
  • Fixed an issue with the difficulty of Wendell: Phobos being too extreme as per this thread
  • Fixed descriptions and typos across a variety of Market items.
  • Fixed Djinn's Fatal Attraction leaving enemies mesmerized permanently if the sentinel was killed while luring.
  • Fixed Djinn being unable to mesmerize enemies without guns (eg: melee-only units).
  • Fixed Acolytes possible dying in missions before they had finished spawning.
  • Fixed Acolytes ragdolling instead of being knocked down.
  • Fixed an issue with Radial Blur staying active on players after enemies who can cause blur are killed (Phorid, etc).
  • Fixed Radial Blind interrupting reloads.
